copy.official: the Bend Park and Recreation District
copy.gary: I've been wandering Bend parks and I still find something new on most visits, like the ducks on Mirror Pond at Drake Park or a misty morning on the Deschutes River Trail.
copy.description: Check in at every Bend, Oregon park you visit, collect stamps and badges, rate your favorites and explore with your Park Pals.

motifs.name: Pilot Butte
motifs.blurb: Pilot Butte is a cinder cone volcano right in town. Walk or drive to the top for a view of the Cascades.

motifs.name: Mirror Pond
motifs.blurb: At Drake Park the Deschutes River widens into Mirror Pond, home to ducks, geese and the best picnic spots downtown.

motifs.name: Whitewater Park
motifs.blurb: The Bend Whitewater Park, on the Deschutes by McKay Park, has a passage for floaters and a standing wave for surfers.

motifs.name: The Cascades
motifs.blurb: From parks all over Bend you can see the Cascade peaks to the west: Mount Bachelor, Broken Top and the Three Sisters.

motifs.name: Ponderosa pines
motifs.blurb: Shevlin Park follows Tumalo Creek through a forest of tall ponderosa pines, Central Oregon's signature tree.

motifs.name: Old Mill smokestacks
motifs.blurb: The Old Mill District's three smokestacks are a reminder of the lumber mills that built Bend along the river.
